Kit summary

Scorching SmokeActive
Attacks a single enemy, dealing [HP Burning] DMG equal to 12% of Suzuran's Max HP and inflicting 1 layer of [Daze] and 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns. [Daze]: reduces Mastery and Skill DMG dealt by 12%, up to 6 layers.
Bewitching SmokeActive
Deals 2 stages of [HP Burning] DMG equal to 6% of Suzuran's Max HP each to a single enemy, then inflicts 1 layer of [Daze]. If the target's [Daze] is at max layers, additionally deals 2 stages of the same DMG.
Radiant Smoke Pipe Lv.1When Bewitching Smoke pursues after Heart-searing Smoke, that attack ignores [Shield], [Immortal] and [DMG Immunity] (non-Boss), deals 6 times DMG to Bosses, and the [Daze] layer requirement for extra DMG is reduced to 4.
Phantasmal SmokePassive
At battle start gains 2 layers of [Smoky Glamour] (+10% Mastery and +10% Bewitching Smoke / Heart-searing Smoke DMG, max 5). When an enemy casts a skill proactively, inflicts 1 layer of [Daze]; when an enemy pursues and attacks, inflicts 2 layers. If the target's [Daze] is at max, she gains the same layers of [Smoky Glamour].
Radiant Smoke Pipe Lv.2Immune to [Daze]. At the first enemy's turn, inflicts 3 layers of [Daze] and [Vanishing] (1 turn; their pursue-and-attack skills become invalid and they take 15% Max HP [HP Burning] DMG ignoring Shield/Immortality/DMG Immunity) on all enemies. Non-Boss enemies with 4+ [Daze] have Mastery RES -50% and get [Vanishing] when pursuing. When other allies inflict [Loong's Wrath], she gains 1 [Smoky Glamour] (no bonuses, max 3, once before each ally acts). With 5 [HP Burning] allies, each time an ally inflicts [Loong's Wrath] on a Boss, all allies gain 30% Turn Meter (once before her action).
Radiant Smoke Pipe Lv.3Invalidates enemy counterattacks and pursue-and-attacks from basic attacks targeting an ally (not herself), up to 2 times, reset at her turn start.
Heart-searing SmokeActive
Deals 4 stages of [HP Burning] DMG equal to 4% of Suzuran's Max HP each to all enemies. For every 1 layer of [Smoky Glamour] she has, casts Bewitching Smoke to pursue and attack once, then consumes all layers.
Radiant Smoke Pipe Lv.3Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns when cast. The first time she has 5 [Smoky Glamour] she immediately casts Heart-searing Smoke, inflicting 1 layer of [Loong's Wrath] on all enemies for 2 turns and raising all allies' Max HP by 20%. Every 5 [Smoky Glamour] gained gives +30% Turn Meter and reduces CD of Bewitching Smoke and Heart-searing Smoke by 1 turn.
Radiant Smoke Pipe (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
